description: S.P. Apparels Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and exports knitted garments for infants and children in India and internationally. The company offers yarns, fabrics, and cotton waste products under the Angel & Rocket brand, as well as dyeing, embroidery, and printing services. It also engages in the manufacture, distribution, marketing, and retail sale of menswear garments under the Crocodile brand name. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Tirupur, India.
